summary: Allow a standalone pool master with no pool peer record to register NFS/SMB storage; an existing invalid record or clustered iSCSI still fails closed. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Restores the already documented NFS/SMB registration workflow on single-host pools; no instructions change.

api.reason: API impact: none. The storage-register command and result contract are unchanged; only Core's local admission gate is corrected.

roadmap.reason: Bug fix within the current storage milestone.

state.reason: No durable state added or changed; storage registrations remain recorded by Core as before.

verification.method: Regression test fails before the fix (standalone NFS refused) and passes after; go vet and go test -race ./internal/agent pass. Not yet re-exercised against a lab host.
